mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a home office addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Constructing a home office addition typically takes several weeks to a few months once permits are approved and site preparation begins. The timeline depends on the complexity of your home's roofline integration, foundation pouring, weather conditions, and inspection scheduling. Before framing starts, plan review and local permit issuance must take place. Throughout the build, our project managers coordinate drywall installation, electrical rough-ins, flooring, and exterior finishing to keep work progressing predictably toward final completion.
